name: UniversalInteraction
shortDescription: Detect what the player aims at in 3D, show its name / available action, then run the right interaction (door, pickup, inspect, talk...).
description: One unified system for 3D games: raycast detection (camera center or cursor, with wall occlusion), prompts (built-in overlay or Text object), highlight outline, and ready-made interactions: open/lock doors with keys, pick up items into an inventory, inspect notes, talk to characters, switches and custom interactions.
Uses the Three.js bundled with GDevelop (only stable APIs: Raycaster, BoxHelper), world-scale aware.
